title: Under release.publish.url the assets workflow check reads the release commit, not the snapshot the run is on
body:
Under release.publish.url the assets workflow runs at the public repository on S, the release commit's snapshot, but both workflow checks read R's tree: the cut's pre-flight (`git cat-file -e "$commit:.github/workflows/$assets_wf"` in lib/cmd/release) and, from ST0011 WP07, `release attach`'s check before it reads the run at the public tag's commit.

S holds only what release.snapshot.list selects from R. A list that leaves `.github/workflows/<assets.workflow>` out passes both checks, and no run of the workflow can exist at S, so the attach waits out assets.wait and fails naming no cause.

Fix: under release.publish.url, check the workflow against the snapshot's selection. The cut has S's tree at its legs step and the snapshot list at pre-flight; `release attach` reads the list from R's tree. The refusal names the list.

A blind spot since issue 0240's publish shape. Ruled for after the 0.1.19 release, low (vc, 2026-11-01, on WP07's critic settle).

Resolution (cc, 2026-11-05 05:33Z by date -u): fixed at e287bea9e5977886ade00374254c1ea7b56a9be2, landed on main by devbin-vc's land-stack.sh from the tested tip f47f5dfb, its tree outside intent/ equal to it, unpushed until the 0.1.20 cut. snapshot_selects (lib/cmd/release), beside _snapshot_select, the one selection a snapshot is made by, answers whether release.snapshot.list at a commit selects a path, the list read through pathlist_specs as snapshot_build reads it. Under release.publish.url the cut's pre-flight asks it of the commit the release commit is made on, and release attach of the tag's commit, before it reads the public tag; each refuses a list that leaves .github/workflows/<assets.workflow> out, naming the list and the line to add, and one whose selection cannot be read, naming why. docs/configuration.md and the release page say so. Two releaseattach.bats arms, the pre-flight's refusal before any gate and the attach's before any gh call, and the attach arm under release.publish.url now names a shipped list that selects the workflow. Its runs, under hv's rule that a fix runs its own arms alone (decision 138), on devbin-vc's desk: in slot 01M6N2MH89DKXJQ7V4KMZ83NRR at 32ce0de8 on 3edf9b0c, then, since 0302 moved releaseattach.bats after that base, in slot 01M6N2YKZD0V43TCR84T561A9F at f47f5dfb on 55a13a51, its changed lines byte-identical; in each, both arms red at main's code with the unit's releaseattach.bats on its own property (main's attach went on to the public tag and stopped on its missing tag, and main's pre-flight named no such cause), and the two arms with the publish.url attach arm green at the tip under BSD, 3 ok of 3. The cut's own gates, kovacs leg and CI are the one full test.

Follow-up (cc, 2026-11-05 06:04Z by date -u): at b548add66ea2f11669e527989b0db531de94b477, landed on main by devbin-vc's land-stack.sh from the tested tip 0a44c3e1 as the top of a two-commit stack, snapshot_selects answers 3, not 2, where the list cannot be read, since contract.bats refuses a literal 2 under lib/cmd unless it marks the dispatcher's meaning, and the cut's contract leg would have gone red on it; its comment says why, and both callers read it through their catch-all, unchanged. The stack's lower commit, 67481c78, did the same for a line of 0323's in lib/cmd/macos, since the arm read green only with both. Its run, in slot 01M6N4PST0NXTYGVKMRVSCDFRM on devbin-vc's desk at 0a44c3e1 on c69e6acc: contract.bats's code-2 arm red at main and green at the stack's tip under BSD.
